# Geobuild

> Geobuild builds self-improving Shopify storefronts: collections sorted 1:1 for each session, and the right audience matched to the right landing page. From discovery to conversion, for Shopify stores.

## Pages

- [Home](https://geobuild.in/): Overview of Geobuild's self-improving storefronts for Shopify
- [Onsite Discovery](https://geobuild.in/products/onsite-discovery): 1:1 session sort: collection pages re-ordered for each shopper from real-time intent, needs and use cases
- [Ad-to-Landing Pages](https://geobuild.in/products/ad-to-landing-pages): A personalized landing page for every ad and channel you run
- [AI Visibility](https://geobuild.in/products/ai-visibility): Getting Shopify stores recommended in AI answers
- [Catalog Enrichment](https://geobuild.in/products/catalog-enrichment): Turning Shopify product data into machine-readable information that AI agents can read
- [Pricing](https://geobuild.in/pricing): Plans and pricing
- [Blog](https://geobuild.in/blog): Playbooks on AI visibility and AI search
- [Answer Engine Optimization](https://geobuild.in/services/answer-engine-optimization): Getting your brand picked in AI answers
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://geobuild.in/services/conversion-rate-optimization): Session-recording review, pain-point analysis and tested fixes for Shopify product pages
- [Get Started](https://geobuild.in/contact-us): Book a 30-minute demo

## About

Geobuild sorts Shopify collections one to one for each session and builds audience-matched landing pages. Connect your ad accounts and Geobuild reads every ad, suggests what each page should say, and builds a landing page that continues the ad, across Google, Meta, TikTok, YouTube and more. A human strategist reviews every suggestion.
